title: Kazakhstan PM tasks digital ministry with assessing resilience of critical communication networks against cyberattacks
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day; the instruction was voiced at a government meeting reported that day.
geo_basis: national government instruction; city not stated in the page
summary: According to Total.kz, Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov told a government meeting that the Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development, with authorised bodies and operators, must assess the resilience of critical communication networks within three months and present a plan. He was quoted as saying cyberattacks, accidents or the shutdown of individual nodes can affect millions of users at once. He also called for closer work between operators, law enforcement and the anti-fraud centre.
plain: Kazakhstan's prime minister has told the digital ministry to check how well critical communication networks would withstand cyberattacks and to produce a plan within three months, Total.kz reports.
exec: Telecom operators in Kazakhstan may face resilience checks, per the prime minister's instruction as reported by Total.kz.

validation.note: One publisher (Total.kz) quoting the prime minister; the government's own release was not found by search.
